name: Geniveve J. Ruskus
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Palo Alto, California

about: Geniveve J. Ruskus is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. She works at Lakin Spears, LLP, located in Palo Alto, California, and provides legal services for issues involving Family Law and Alternative Dispute Resolution to the surrounding community.
Geniveve Ruskus completed legal studies at University of California Los Angeles (UCLA) School of Law and graduated with the class of 1996. Geniveve Ruskus passed the bar in 1996.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
